stock.corpusModelLines.v1.unit: scheme model line by corpus generation
stock.corpusModelLines.v1.basis: The retained corpus carries a generation code but no model names. F70 and G42 map to the scheme lines of the same name; G61 is taken as the G61 i5 line because fleet-plan.json maps T5MJ (G61E) to it. Generated stock reads the demo fleet corpus (Gary, 11 November 2026), which also carries G21, G26, U10 and U11; U11 maps to the X1 line, so iX1 cars count as X1 and U10 iX2 cars as X2. Display names drop the generation code.

identity.demo.principals.basis: Synthetic principals; grade/scheme IDs follow eligibility mapping. Greg's employee and ordering roles authorised 11 November 2026. G7 is an assumed, revisable grade; slot-greg is his own entitlement.

eligibility.context.mapping.basis: Demo scheme/company IDs and source grade bands preserve actual FS&UK and RR&Production matrices. RR&Production is not equated with UKNSC. eligibilityModelKey is exact source model + | + one source engine token; comma/slash alternatives expand without inventing engine prefixes.

employee.recommendation.v1.basis: Existing rankCars preference curves with separate importance/indifference and confirmed exact evidence. Collaborator direction, 11 November 2026: use more of the allowance among similarly matched eligible cars; five preference-score points defines a revisable similarity band. No retail cash budget. Quote terms remain pinned for the full 7,200-second buddy hold. Demo calibration is revisable, not BMW policy. Collaborator-reviewed option mappings, 11 November: invisible equipment preference at importance 100; desirability weights 0..3. Shared fixed saturation scale (eight desirability points gives 50/100); supporting slider evidence moves five points per reviewed unit, capped at twenty. Unresolved packages use conservative overlapping-capability fallbacks, not inferred contents. Only selected active catalogue configuration/fitted evidence counts. These calibration values are revisable assumptions.

brief.lifecycle.v1.basis: Charging readiness is an explicit practical demo input, not a BMW home-charging rule. Q16 permits one confirmed field change for a recorded decline. Unknown is represented by null and needs-confirmation.

eligibility.homeCharging.requiredForPlug.basis: Demo assumption only, not a BMW rule. Assumed demo practical gate from brief; target has no such BMW rule (round-2). Unknown/not-ready charging prevents a plug-in offer under this assumption.
